meta.name: security-research
meta.description: Team Mode security research skill. Orchestrates 3 vulnerability hunters and 2 PoC engineers to audit a codebase in parallel, prove exploitability, classify root causes, and calibrate severity by actual exploitability. Use for security review, vulnerability research, exploitability audit, pre-release security check, threat model validation, and `/security-research`. Triggers: 'security-research', 'security research', 'security review', 'vulnerability audit', 'exploitability audit', '보안 리뷰', '취약점 감사'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行审计代码库，发现漏洞并验证可利用性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要对代码库进行深度安全审查并验证漏洞可利用性
copy.tagline_en: Audit codebases in parallel, find vulnerabilities and verify exploitability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need deep security review of codebases with exploitability validation

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会临时组建一个 5 人“安全小组”(3 人找漏洞、2 人写验证代码),并行检查代码,把真正能利用的问题和一般风险分开,最后给出「通过/通过但有发现/阻止」结论和修复建议。
howto.when: 当你说「security-research」「security review」等关键词,或要求做安全审查、漏洞研究、发布前安全检查,或输入 `/security-research` 时触发。前提:已开启团队模式、处于主会话、有明确审查对象。

say.text: 审计当前仓库的代码,找出可被利用的漏洞。
say.note: 会启动 5 人小组并行检查当前分支。

say.text: 重点检查登录鉴权和文件上传接口,证明哪里真能被利用。
say.note: 3 个猎手分工扫描,2 名工程师尝试复现。

say.text: 对这次 PR 的 diff 做发布前安全审查。
say.note: 只审计改动范围,输出严重级别和建议。

howto.what_en: Claude spawns a 5-member team (3 hunters, 2 PoC engineers) to audit code in parallel, separate real exploitable issues from generic ones, and deliver a PASS / PASS WITH FINDINGS / BLOCK verdict with fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggers on 'security-research', 'security review', security-review or vulnerability-audit requests, or '/security-research'. Needs team mode, main session, a concrete target.

say_en.text: Audit the current repository for exploitable vulnerabilities.
say_en.note: Starts the 5-member parallel audit on the current branch.

say_en.text: Check the auth and file-upload paths; prove what is actually exploitable.
say_en.note: Hunters scan their areas; PoC engineers try to reproduce.

say_en.text: Run a pre-release security review on this PR's diff.
say_en.note: Only the changed scope is audited, then rated with fixes.
